A Word

From Our Director

“Welcome to Laugh ‘n’ Learn Day Nursery, where playing and learning go hand in hand. 

I am a passionate individual when it comes to the learning and development of the children in our care because I believe children are our future.  We endeavour to meet the needs of all children and their families, ensuring your child’s welfare is always a priority. I work closely with my team to ensure we all share the same vision in order to deliver a high quality service to you and your family. Our nurseries are equipped to cater for children from birth till they are ready for school, so you can have peace of mind your child will flourish from milestone to milestone in a secure and stable environment. If your child requires any additional support we work closely with families and other professionals to enable us to provide the best possible opportunities for your child(ren).

Contact our settings for some friendly advice and information. We look forward to meeting you.

Ayesha Iqbal
